written_utc: registered by the commit that adds this file: 12/10 ~19:45 UTC, after the A/B/C export of the centred network started and before stage 45, any upload and any site score
label: t40: centred bridge network. Same ensemble as Alfredo·t39 (10 seeds 2-11 fitted on all ten cube groups, conditioned on each context's official controls), but the low-rank residual U r is centred over the 300 panel targets of each context (arm rete_centrata of EMENDAMENTO_R2), then each target rescaled to the norm of the all export x 1.576; t28 emission (effects-scale 1.5, gene dispersion 1.0, seed 20260912). Against Alfredo·t39 only the centring changes.
status: owner's request in chat on 12/10 ('sperimenta un po' ... mettiamo qualcosa a gradare sul sito (scadenza alle due nella nostra fascia oraria)'): the go for one upload today
why_this_one: ESITO_T39 (reports/analisi/prove_per_davide_2026-10-07/ESITO_T39.md) left one open check: t39 lost the PDS member (-0.055 scaled vs t28, -0.023 vs t36) and the most likely cause is the common response the residual adds (about 1% of the site's energy, 2-31% on the cube lines). Centring removes it using predictions only. It is the clean site test of that hypothesis.
ceiling_note: small by construction (impact criterion): the realistic best is about +0.01 over t39, i.e. ~0.151, just above Davide·t38 (0.148922). It is chosen because it is the only learned candidate that can be built, generated and uploaded inside today's window and that answers a registered question.

evidence_before.bench: rete_ponte_jepa_2026-10-09/ESITO.md: centring takes a quarter to a third of the cube cosine gain (r3 +0.050 -> +0.033, r4 +0.046 -> +0.034); centred, the K562 PDS improves, H1's does not; the bench overestimates the site PDS in five cases out of five
evidence_before.site: t39 members vs t36: PDS -0.023 scaled, fidelity +0.019, nMAE +0.002; raw PDS cosine 0.781 (t28), 0.767 (t36), 0.757 (t39)

expected.members: scaled PDS up vs t39 (probability 0.65), between 0 and +0.03; fidelity and nMAE within +-0.01 of t39; scaled MSE stays 0

rule.a: t40 - t39 >= +0.005: the common-response hypothesis is supported on the site; the centred network replaces t39 as our network, and the next step is the same centring on top of the extended bank (with Davide)
rule.b: |t40 - t39| < 0.005: not conclusive; centring does not explain the t39 loss at a measurable scale
rule.c: t40 - t39 <= -0.005: the hypothesis falls: the common part of the residual was not what cost t39 on the site
rule.also_reported: the six scaled members against t39, t36 and t28; t40 against Davide·t38 (0.148922) as a non-registered comparison
rule.not: one seed of the generator; nothing direct about D, E, F
